title: Learn how to use Claude like a pro for just $14
excerpt: Become a more confident Claude user with this four-course bundle.
content_html:
TL;DR: Master the ins and outs of Claude with this Claude AI Professional E-Degree, now just $14 (reg. $159) with code COURSE30 until Aug. 2.

Credit: Eduonix Learning Solutions

$14

You’ve heard of Claude. Now it’s time to learn how to actually use it. This Claude AI Professional E-Degree schools you on the ins and outs of this AI model, so you don’t miss the boat on how helpful it can be.

Right now, you can lock in this E-Degree for just $14 with code COURSE30 through Aug. 2.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Sure, AI can be great. But if you’re not using it correctly, you could get the wrong results and waste time in the process. That’s where the Claude AI Professional E-Degree comes into play, showing you how to get the most out of using Claude and go from beginner to expert user.

Get ready to become a Claude expert with the four informative courses packed in this E-Degree. Each course is taught by Eduonix Learning Solutions, a team of industry professionals who teach you how to work with technology as it’s actually used.

These four hands-on modules include eight hours of video that walk you through building effective prompts, one of the most important skills for working with AI.

See how to build a website, set up an automated system, or create practical projects for marketing workflows. You’ll also learn more complex tasks, like mastering the chain-of-thought workflows that can help you improve your answers from Claude.

Freelancers and creators will appreciate learning how to connect Claude to Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Chrome, MCP connectors, and productivity tools. And if you’re a developer, you’ll appreciate the AI-assisted coding workflows and debugging techniques available to you.

After you go through the courses, there are quizzes to help you test your skills. You’ll also receive a professional eDegree certification once you finish them.

Snag this Claude AI Professional E-Degree, now just $14 (reg. $159) with code COURSE30 until Aug. 2.
